newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RFM savings bank investment approved.
newsitem.headline: RFM savings bank investment approved.

text.p: Philippine regulators have approved the entry of the RFM Group and its allies as the new majority shareholders of Consumer Savings Bank, the Central Bank said in a statement on Friday.
Consumer Savings Bank will have an authorised capital stock of 500 million pesos.

About 30 percent, or 150 million pesos, has been paid-in with the RFM Group subscribing to 55 percent. The other shareholders with a 10 percent stake each are the Philflex, Yupangco, Abenson and Panlilio groups, the statement said.
The new savings bank plans to tap the network of suppliers, distributors and dealers of RFM Corp, a food and beverage concern.
